judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The finding says nothing around the link explains it, but the link text names the action ('iniciar uma conversa', start a conversation). It sits under the preceding h1 'Sala de Imprensa (exclusivo para jornalistas)' (H80, link text combined with the preceding heading). The same contact box lists 'Contato: João (Pensata Assessoria)', his email and the number +55 (21) 99987-6094. In context the purpose is clear: start a conversation with the press contact. The patch only adds the name of the app (WhatsApp), which is a rewording that 2.4.4 at Level A does not require.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: 'Fatura Verde' is a project link in the footer column headed 'Visite outros projetos', and the text correctly names its intended purpose. The snapshot shows /fatura-verde/ redirects to /404 ('Página não encontrada'), which makes it a broken link. That is a functional defect, not a failure of link purpose. 2.4.4 asks whether the text describes the purpose, not whether the destination works. The suggested '(Página não encontrada)' label is not an accessibility fix.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: In WCAG, a label is text presented to all users, and a hidden aria-label is the accessible name. The only visible label for this field is the placeholder 'CPF*', which states exactly what to enter (the Brazilian CPF number). The hidden aria-label 'document' also roughly describes it, since a CPF is an identity document number. The real defect is that the visible 'CPF' is not in the accessible name 'document', which is 2.5.3 Label in Name, not 2.4.6. The 2.4.6 label describes its purpose.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The finding says 'phone' does not say what to enter, but it plainly names the expected input, a phone number. The visible placeholder label 'Telefone*' also describes it. The patch just translates 'phone' to 'Telefone', a rewording of a label that already describes its purpose. A mismatch between language and visible label would be 3.1.2 or 2.5.3, not 2.4.6.
